info.title: Tambo API
info.description:
Anti-theft backend: auth (email OTP), devices, evidence ingest, theft episodes, location trail, buddies, legal acceptance, and the signed evidence pack.

**Error contract**: every non-2xx response is `{ code, message }` (schema `Error`). Branch on `code`, never on `message` - messages are wording and will change; codes are contract.

**Legacy alias**: every `/api/v1/auth/*` path is also served at `/api/auth/*` for pre-OpenAPI mobile builds; new clients use the versioned paths.

tags.name: Auth (web)
tags.description: The PWA session surface: refresh token in an httpOnly cookie (path /api/auth/web), X-Tambo-Csrf header required, fetch with credentials: "include". Access token stays in memory.

tags.name: Client
tags.description: Every request from a current client carries X-Client-Platform (android | ios | web) and X-Client-Version (X.Y.Z). Both are advisory: recorded on sessions, never required.

tags.name: Partners
tags.description: White-label partners: the admin catalogue, and partner systems authenticating with X-Api-Key.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Partner endpoints hearing about their fleet. Each POST carries Tambo-Event-Id, Tambo-Event-Type and Tambo-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" keyed with the endpoint secret>. Any 2xx acknowledges; anything else is retried (8 attempts over ~45 h). Delivery is at-least-once: dedup on the event id. Redirects are not followed.

post.summary: Enrol a device (returns its one-shot ingest token)
post.description: Gated on current T&C + privacy acceptance. The ingestToken appears in this response and never again - only its hash is stored. The device joins `partnerCode`'s fleet, or the owner's partner when omitted. With an `installId` the call is idempotent per (owner, install): the app may enrol on every sign-in, and a known install gets a fresh token for its existing device (the old token stops working).

post.summary: A provisioned phone claims its ingest token (no account)
post.description: Device-first enrolment (docs/provisioning-api.md). The phone trades the provisioning token its partner gave it for an ingest token and starts protecting before anyone signs in. `installId` is a random id the app keeps per install: the same install may retry a claim whose response was lost (200, the ingest token rotates) until the phone is linked; any other install gets 409. When the server enforces Play Integrity, `integrityToken` is required and its request hash must be sha256("tambo-claim:<provisioningToken>:<installId>") in hex.

post.summary: Ask the stolen phone to snapshot, locate, or ring
post.description: Only while the device has an open episode. The phone is woken by a silent push when it has a device-scoped push token, and otherwise picks the command up on its next poll or ingest reply. Repeating a type that is still outstanding converges on it (200) instead of queueing another. cameras applies to snapshot only, durationSeconds to ring only.

command.description: A command as the owner sees it, with where it got to.
